a forest hero on the new-session page"},{"id":"p51s1","text":"packages/dsh-forest-adventure"},{"id":"p52s1","text":"Forest Companion dark"},{"id":"p53s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p54s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p55s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p56s1","text":"The skins have no dependencies on each other, so there is no incremental build — a full one is fast "},{"id":"p56s2","text":"enough that the complexity would buy nothing."},{"id":"p57s1","text":"To publish a change to one skin, bump the `version` in its `package.json`: CI decides what to publis"},{"id":"p57s2","text":"h by whether a version already has a matching Release tag, and skips every package whose version was"},{"id":"p57s3","text":" a version already has a matching Release tag, and skips every package whose version was not bumped."},{"id":"p58s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p59s1","text":"### Directory layout"},{"id":"p60s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p61s1","text":"Not committing `lib/` is the biggest difference from the standalone-repository era: back then skins "},{"id":"p61s2","text":"installed via `github:owner/repo` and what you installed was the output in the repository, so leavin"},{"id":"p61s3","text":"g it out shipped an empty shell. Now that distribution goes through Release tarballs, `npm pack` pac"},{"id":"p61s4","text":"ks the built `lib/` according to `files`, and committing it would only bloat the repository."},{"id":"p62s1","text":"## Want to build your own?"},{"id":"p63s1","text":"The fastest route is to copy any skin under `packages/` — they all share one structure, and `skin.js"},{"id":"p63s2","text":"on`, `cordis.patch.yml` and `src/client/tokens.ts` are the whole entry point."},{"id":"p64s1","text":"When it is ready, you are welcome to publish it on the DSH skin market, where anyone can browse and "},{"id":"p64s2","text":"install without logging in."},{"id":"p65s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p66s1","text":"MIT © Science Roam Limited"},{"id":"p67s1","text":"If this is useful to you, a Star goes a long way"}],"truncated":true}
